headline: Calpine fleet lifts earnings; full-year outlook raised
summary_short: Constellation's Q3 2026 GAAP EPS was $5.19 and adjusted operating EPS $5.06, versus $3.04 a year ago; it raised the midpoint of its full-year adjusted EPS range to $12.50-$12.80.
summary_long: Adjusted operating earnings rose to $1.79 billion, reflecting favorable market and portfolio conditions and the addition of Calpine, partly offset by unfavorable interest and nuclear PTC portfolio effects. Nuclear output was 46,677 GWh at a 97.2% capacity factor excluding Salem and STP. Year-to-date share repurchases were $3.0 billion. It agreed to acquire the Rhode Island State Energy Center and signed a 20-year, 270 MW Peak+ agreement from its nuclear fleet starting in 2028.
confidence_notes: Shard KPIs are Yahoo-sourced (revenue, EBITDA, net income); the release was read for narrative and non-GAAP EPS. Year-on-year comparisons are inflated by the Calpine acquisition (closed January 2026; diluted shares 354M vs 313M). Guidance (FY2026 adjusted operating EPS $12.50-$12.80, midpoint raised) is stated in the release but not written to the event shard (no sanctioned script).
